# JavaPlay — Free J2ME Emulator (by CodeLove)

> Play 163 classic Java (.jar) mobile phone games online in your browser or with a 245 KB Android app featuring a real T9 keypad.

## Pages
- [Home](https://javaplay.codelove.in/): JavaPlay features, game showcase, and Android APK download.
- [Play in Browser](https://javaplay.codelove.in/play): Interactive HTML5/JS J2ME phone emulator.
